annotations.title: UN number to permitted UN packaging

description: Look up a dangerous goods UN number (or substance name) in ADR 2025 Table A and its packing instructions. Returns class, packing group, limited quantity, UN mark level and, for each container type (jerrican, drum, IBC, composite), the UN codes allowed and the largest size in litres. Covers 72 UN numbers of liquids.
